title: Affine quotient charts detect degree-zero condensed closed exchange
statement: For an arbitrary commutative condensed coefficient ring $\Lambda$ in the small-site universe [def-weil-size-convention], let $f:X\to Y$ be quasi-compact and quasi-separated [def-weil-quasi-separated-morphism] and $c:C\hookrightarrow Y$ closed [def-weil-closed-immersion]. For an arbitrary internal module sheaf $M$, suppose that for every affine open $v:\operatorname{Spec}A\to Y$ [def-weil-open-immersion], every ideal $I\subseteq A$, and every cartesian presentation of the pullback of $c$ as $\operatorname{Spec}(A/I)$, the exact-pullback exchange [lem-sfb-closed-test-derived-exchange-model] for the corresponding localized square is invertible on $(a^*M)[0]$, where $a:X\times_Y\operatorname{Spec} A\to X$. Then the actual ambient exchange for the canonical pullback square of $f,c$ is invertible on $M[0]$. All pullbacks use the ordinary internal-module derived operations [sk-def-sfb-module-derived-pushpull]. No properness, admissibility, constructibility or finiteness of Tor amplitude is required.

proof.text: Choose the affine open cover v_i:Spec(A_i)→Y. For each i, the closed immersion pullback(c,v_i)→Spec(A_i) is Spec(A_i/I_i) by Mathlib IsClosedImmersion.Spec_iff. Transport the standard pullback square by this isomorphism. Replace the domains of the base-change open cover of C by these quotient spectra using Cover.copy. Regard this as a pro-etale cover via Etale and etalePrecoverage_le_proetalePrecoverage. This construction includes empty Y and C.

For each quotient chart form the canonical pullbacks XU and XZ. Apply the one-open restriction comparison to the global chosen pullback square and these local presentations. The exact pullback of M[0] is canonically isomorphic to (a*M)[0] by mapDerivedCategorySingleFunctor. NatTrans.isIso_app_iff_of_iso transports the assumed local invertibility across this specified isomorphism. Hence the restriction of the actual global ambient exchange is invertible on every quotient chart.

Apply the isomorphism clause of condensed_cover_restriction_conservative to the quotient-chart pro-etale cover of C and the actual global exchange component. This concludes invertibility without changing the original signature.

theorem condensed_closed_exchange_affine_descent
    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1})
    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ]
    {X Y C : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (c : C ⟶ Y) [IsClosedImmersion c]
    (M : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj Λ X))
    (hloc : ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A)
      (XU XZ : Scheme.{u}) (v : Spec (.of A) ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion v]
      (a : XU ⟶ X) (fU : XU ⟶ Spec (.of A))
      (b : Spec (.of (A ⧸ I)) ⟶ C)
      (h : XZ ⟶ XU) (fZ : XZ ⟶ Spec (.of (A ⧸ I)))
      (_wf : IsPullback a fU f v)
      (_wc : IsPullback b (ClosedTestDerivedExchangeModel.closedMap A I) c v)
      (w : IsPullback h fZ fU (ClosedTestDerivedExchangeModel.closedMap A I)),
      IsIso ((ClosedTestDerivedExchangeModel.exchange Λ w.toCommSq).app
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj ((upperStar Λ a).obj M)))) :
    IsIso ((condensedAmbientExchange Λ
      (g' := pullback.fst f c) (f' := pullback.snd f c) (f := f) (g := c)
      { w := pullback.condition
        isoPullback := Iso.refl _
        hom_fst := Category.id_comp _
        hom_snd := Category.id_comp _ }).app ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj M))
